answer_1.quote: ... uses advanced LLMs to automatically curate two instructional datasets: (1) COMMINST, a set of open-ended instructions ... and (2) COMMSURVEY, a set of multi-choice survey questions ... These instruction-response pairs are used to finetune foundational LLMs ...
answer_1.outputs: instruction-response pairs and multi-choice question-answer pairs

answer_2.quote: ... Accuracy is calculated by comparing the model's answers to the "semi-ground truths" ... We compute the pairwise agreement between different communities using their responses to questions in COMMSURVEY ...

answer_4.quote: ... We verify the "semi-ground truths" by human annotation, as detailed in Appendix C ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to search the relevant posts from the subreddit and learn their views from the discussions, instead of solely relying on their pre-assumption about the community.
